sentences.en: The students were recalcitrant about following the new rules.
sentences.zh: 学生们对新规定很顽抗，不愿意遵守。

sentences.en: Despite repeated warnings, he remained recalcitrant and was eventually fired.
sentences.zh: 尽管多次警告，他依然抗拒，最终被解雇了。

sentences.en: The teacher found the class particularly recalcitrant today, making it difficult to teach.
sentences.zh: 老师发现今天这个班特别顽抗，教起来很不容易。
